```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
#| label: penguins-glimpse
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
head(penguins)

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-penguins-plot
#| fig-cap: "Scatter plot of bill length vs bill depth for Adelie penguins"


penguins %>%
  filter(species == "Adelie") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = bill_length_mm,
    y = bill_depth_mm
  )) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE)
```
